name: LAMMPS
summary: A classical molecular dynamics code; this Hub bundle models two self-contained Lennard-Jones examples.
scope: DIPL input generation for the pinned examples/melt/in.melt and examples/min/in.min scripts.
validation_qualifier: Eight adapter tests passed against the pinned source on 2026-10-09. Active commands match both upstream LJ examples, and both generated setups completed local serial smoke runs. Scientific-result validation is not claimed.
limitations: This independent external adapter covers only two self-contained Lennard-Jones examples, not the LAMMPS input language or package catalogue. The local build and two smoke runs do not establish scientifically validated simulation results, other-platform support, or upstream endorsement.
